evals.expected_output: Enumerates open renovate PRs per org repo, triages each by check state, lands eligible ones, and reports the rest with blocking reasons.
evals.prompt: Do the daily renovate sweep across shikanime-labs and shikanime-studio.
assertions: Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body enumerates open PRs authored by renovate across org repos
Body lands only PRs with green checks on the exact head
Body reports non-landed PRs with their blocking reasons

evals.expected_output: A PR red with a required check failure is never merged past the gate — it gets read, reported, and left open.
evals.prompt: That renovate PR is red on a required check but just admin-merge it anyway.
assertions: Body states a red required check is never merged past

evals.expected_output: A chronically red renovate PR (3+ days, same error) becomes a summary issue instead of being reported forever.
evals.prompt: This same renovate PR has been failing with the same error since Monday — what does the sweep do about it?
assertions: Body escalates PRs red for 3+ consecutive days into a summary issue

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies; authoring renovate config is out of scope.
evals.prompt: Write me a renovate.json with custom package rules and a schedule for our monorepo.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
